# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Login code sign-in

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com (Production)

For car head units (Android Auto, CarPlay) and other devices where scanning a QR code is impractical. The user reads a short code from a signed-in device and types it on the new device.

1. On a signed-in device, call `POST /api/auth/pairing-code` and show the 6-character code to the user.
2. The user enters the code on the new device, which calls `POST /api/auth/redeem-code`.
3. The new device receives a bearer token.

Codes expire after 5 minutes and can be redeemed only once.

### `POST /api/auth/pairing-code` — Create a login code

Auth: `Bearer`

Creates a 6-character login code for the signed-in user. No request body. The code is valid for 5 minutes and can be redeemed once with `POST /api/auth/redeem-code` on another device. Codes use uppercase letters and digits and never contain the ambiguous characters `0`, `O`, `1` or `I`.

**Requires a bearer token.**

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  code?: string | null
  expiresAt?: date-time
}
```

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `POST /api/auth/redeem-code` — Redeem a login code

Auth: none

Exchanges a login code for a bearer token. `code` is case-insensitive. Returns `404` when the code is invalid, expired or already used. Requests are rate limited per client.

Request body `application/json`:

```ts
{
  code: string  // min length: 1; pattern: ^[A-HJ-NP-Za-hj-np-z2-9]{6}$
}
```

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  token?: string | null
}
```
